questions.text: Выбери верную форму: ___ a sofa in the living room.

options.text: There is
There are
There am

questions.explanation: Sofa — единственное число, поэтому there is.

questions.text: Как правильно: «В нашем доме две двери»?

options.text: There are two doors in our house.
There is two doors in our house.
There two doors in our house.

questions.explanation: Doors — множественное число, поэтому there are.

questions.text: В каких предложениях there is/are использован верно? (выбери все верные варианты)

options.text: There are five chairs in the kitchen.
There is a lamp on the table.
There are a carpet on the floor.
There is three pictures on the wall.
There isn't a TV in my room.

questions.explanation: Carpet (один) требует there is, pictures (много) — there are. Chairs — мн. ч. → are, lamp — ед. ч. → is, отрицание isn't с TV верно.

options.text: Is there
Are there
There is

questions.explanation: Cat — единственное число, вопрос: Is there...?

questions.text: There ___ any books on the shelf. (отрицание)

options.text: aren't
isn't
don't

questions.text: Задай вопрос: There are four rooms in the flat. → ___ there four rooms in the flat?
questions.explanation: Со множественным числом (rooms) вопрос начинается с Are there...?

questions.text: Впиши одно слово: There ___ a big window in my bedroom.
questions.explanation: Window — единственное число, поэтому there is.

pairs.left: Is there a computer in your room? (да)
Are there any cups on the table? (нет)
Is there a bath in the bathroom? (нет)
Are there two beds in the bedroom? (да)

questions.explanation: Краткий ответ повторяет there is/there are: ед. ч. — is/isn't, мн. ч. — are/aren't.

questions.text: Составь отрицание: There is a clock on the wall.

options.text: There isn't a clock on the wall.
There aren't a clock on the wall.
There don't a clock on the wall.

questions.explanation: Clock — единственное число, отрицание there isn't.
